boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission activities and spaces documented by Mississippi State University sources.

cards.title: Take a DIY portrait
cards.subtitle: MaxxSouth Digital Media Center, Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a phone and use the studio’s backdrops, lighting, and phone stand for a shared headshot or a fresh profile photo.
cards.short_summary: A library photo studio with self-portrait equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU states that the photography studio in the MaxxSouth Digital Media Center is free to use and open to students, faculty, staff, and community patrons.
cards.source_title: Picture-Perfect Spot: New library photo studio opens for students, employees, patrons
cards.access_notes: Available during Digital Media Center hours; the cited source says it is open to students, faculty, staff, and community patrons.

cards.entity_name: Computer Commons at Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.title: Explore public government information
cards.subtitle: Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Meet at the Computer Commons and browse federal information together; start with a topic, place, or historic event you both want to investigate.
cards.short_summary: Free public computers alongside federal government information.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries says public access to government documents is guaranteed by public law and that free public computer access is available in the Computer Commons.
cards.access_notes: Located in Mitchell Memorial Library; the page specifically identifies free public computer access.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset
cards.subtitle: Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the room individually for quiet reflection, prayer, or meditation, then reconnect outside the library for a low-key check-in.
cards.short_summary: An unlocked reflection room for all religious and nonreligious beliefs.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries describes this as an unlocked, unreservable room for prayer, meditation, or reflection that is available whenever Mitchell Memorial Library is open.
cards.access_notes: Individual use only; unlocked and not reservable. Available whenever Mitchell Memorial Library is open.

cards.title: Play a pickleball set
cards.subtitle: Sanderson Center
cards.notes: Bring a partner or make a casual foursome at the eight outdoor courts; check the recreation reservation system before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Eight campus pickleball courts with no player charge.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU reports that the Sanderson Center’s eight pickleball courts are free and open for all players.
cards.source_title: University Recreation opens new MSU pickleball courts at Sanderson
cards.access_notes: The university directs groups to its recreation reservation system for group reservations; bring any needed equipment.

cards.title: Join International Fiesta
cards.subtitle: MSU Drill Field
cards.notes: When the annual event returns, arrive for the Parade of Flags and stay for performances, activities, and cultural organization booths without buying food.
cards.short_summary: An annual Drill Field cultural celebration with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU’s Center for Student Activities says International Fiesta is held annually on the Drill Field and that admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; confirm the next date with the Center for Student Activities. Food and merchandise from vendors cost extra.

cards.entity_name: John F. and Jeanne A. Marszalek Library Fund Lecture Series
cards.title: Catch a history lecture
cards.subtitle: John Grisham Room, Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Watch for the annual program and attend the graduate-research presentation and guest lecture; a reception and book signing may follow.
cards.short_summary: An annual library lecture pairing student research with a guest historian.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU describes the 2026 Marszalek Lecture as a free, public annual program held in Mitchell Memorial Library’s John Grisham Room.
cards.source_title: MSU hosts 2026 Marszalek Lecture with award-winning Civil War historian
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 program was free and open to the public; consult MSU Libraries for the next annual event date.

cards.title: See the summer musical
cards.subtitle: McComas Hall
cards.notes: Check the next summer production dates and attend the student-created musical with friends; no ticket purchase was required for the 2026 performances.
cards.short_summary: A yearly student theater program that stages an original musical.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU announced that 2026 Summer Scholars On Stage performances at McComas Hall were free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Face the Music(Fest): MSU Summer Scholars take stage June 26, 27
cards.access_notes: The source documents free public performances on June 26–27, 2026; confirm future production dates before going.

cards.title: Try science demonstrations
cards.subtitle: Hilbun Hall and The Cobb Institute
cards.notes: Look for the next Science Night and work through the demonstrations and exhibits together; the university lists it as suitable for all ages.
cards.short_summary: A campus evening of science demonstrations, activities, and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Museums and Galleries described Science Night at the Museums as free and open to the public, with demonstrations, activities, and exhibits for all ages.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 event was held at Hilbun Hall and The Cobb Institute; check Museums and Galleries for a future date.

cards.title: Attend a campus poetry reading
cards.subtitle: Old Main Academic Center, Room 1030
cards.notes: Follow MSU English event listings for future readings; bring a friend, listen to the selections, and stay for any announced Q&A.
cards.short_summary: A free public poetry reading and discussion in Old Main.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU stated that Robert West’s 2026 reading in Old Main Academic Center was free and open to the public and included a question-and-answer session.
cards.source_title: MSU poet gives ‘A Clear Eye’ reading April 20
cards.access_notes: The cited reading occurred April 20, 2026. A book signing followed, but purchasing a book was optional.

cards.title: Hear a recital in the Music Building
cards.subtitle: Music Building Recital Hall
cards.notes: Check Department of Music listings for the next public recital, then settle in for a performance without needing to buy admission.
cards.short_summary: A documented free public classical recital in the Music Building.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU announced that its 2026 Victor Rosenbaum Schubertiade in the Music Building Recital Hall was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: MSU welcomes internationally acclaimed pianist Victor Rosenbaum for free concert this week
cards.access_notes: The cited recital occurred February 5, 2026; verify future Department of Music recital dates and access details.

warnings: Several cards document annual or one-time 2026 programs; confirm the next occurrence before visiting.
